Since the former fd56f083 base, the only source changes are T753 RecruitmentDesk.tsx and its test; these do not intersect projection, operatingCosts, ratio/roundShare, ownerClose, signings, contracts or their dependencies. HIST r24 attributes career cards to recorded match sides and permits missing/recognized obsolete summary reconstruction; SAVE r66 limits optional-data discard to recognized obsolete own-career card summaries and explicitly preserves canonical facts, current-summary validation and unknown/future rejection. T758 neither reads nor writes those summaries or save lifecycle paths, and its loan terms, payment facts and pure projection behavior are compatible with the updated policies. The implementation still subtracts the exact unpaid cumulative-rounded installment from both season bounds, gives continuing loans one full installment across the year horizon, and gives final-term loans only the unpaid current installment; a separate labelled row removes the same amount from operating costs, avoiding a second charge. No-loan/expired-term cases and read immutability remain correct. The real signingVerdict regression intentionally changes affordability under unchanged staff thresholds; integration expectation edits remain limited to loan itemization. Existing exact-source evidence is reused explicitly rather than rerun: 31 new cases reproduce 19 failures before correction, 36 focused cases and 128 files/1173 affected cases pass, with type/lint/format/i18n/build; the earlier independent 376 numeric comparisons covered every played-round horizon, half-even ties and a beyond-Number integer. Integration-tier projection tests and the final full/browser gate remain coordinator-owned.

reviewHistory.summary: T758 satisfies its four acceptance items and the complete current ECON-18, ECON-38 and ARCH-9 contracts at base fd56f083210f3dc89d70754753c45bafa561d167. Reviewed pinned commit d8f9498d5e604c5ba56253840bfcb5d89f75887f and its complete diff. The season horizon subtracts annual minus cumulative half-even rounded paid loan installments, matching the telescoping roundShare payment schedule. The 365-day horizon itemizes one full installment for a continuing loan and only the current unpaid installment in its final term, removing the loan from operating costs to avoid double counting. Both low/high cash bounds reconcile with their labelled signed rows. No-loan and expired-term behavior, source-world immutability, existing rates/terms/payments/ledger and staff-policy thresholds are preserved. The actual signingVerdict regression demonstrates the intentional affordability change. Integration-test edits are limited to the added loan label and excluding its separately itemized amount from operating-row expectations. Reused exact-submission evidence: 31 new cases (19 failing before the correction), 36 focused cases including unchanged loan settlement coverage, 128 files/1173 affected unit cases, typecheck/lint/format/i18n/build pass. An additional read-only numeric diagnostic checked all 47 played-round horizons for 8 installments, including half-even ties and an integer beyond Number precision; all 376 telescoping comparisons matched. Upstream next still equals the pinned base, with no overlapping changes. Integration-tier projection.test.ts/projection.plain.test.ts and the final full/browser gate remain coordinator-owned as explicitly authorized.
